method_note: The point is the single OneMap address-search feature for the address BDx gives on its SIN1 facility page (110 Paya Lebar Road, Singapore). The served WGS84 latitude/longitude was re-derived from the served SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy, EPSG:3414 -> EPSG:4326); the difference is below 0.0001 m. A search for the returned postcode 409009 gave a byte-identical single result. No geocoding beyond the official address search, no offsets and no rounding were applied. BDx's 'View on Map' link and any map imagery on its page were not used.
